title: template.massremove
description: Remove related objects from multiple templates.

templateids.description: IDs of the templates to be updated. Parameter behavior: required.

groupids.description: IDs of the template groups from which to remove the given templates.

macros.description: IDs of the user macros to delete from the given templates.

templateids_clear.description: IDs of the templates to unlink and clear from the given templates (upstream).

templateids_link.description: IDs of the templates to unlink from the given templates (upstream).
